text:
Gracie (partnerships): Heads-up: Azure Marketplace PO AMZ-45812 failed with vendor_ledger_mismatch + shipping-country mismatch. Partner says shipping from IE but billing is US EIN. Can legal/procurement triage?
mp-bot: PO AMZ-45812 status=FAILED; code=409; reason=vendor_ledger_mismatch; link=https://azure.marketplace/po/AMZ-45812
Rafael (procurement): Looks like partner submitted invoice showing IE VAT reg but marketplace ledger tied to AcmeCloud US (EIN 12-3456789).
Liam (sales): Customer is prepping a joint announcement next week. Delay would push launch and co-marketing. Any fast route to unblock?
Priya (legal): Two quick checks: do we have partner's IE VAT cert and US W-9 on file? If so, partnerops can request ledger split but that still needs reconciliation.
Jordan (finance): Finance can approve a one-off manual accept if procurement & legal confirm tax treatment. We'll need partner to sign tax indemnity.
Gracie (partnerships): Partner uploaded VAT-IE-7788 and W9-ACMEUS.pdf in the ticket. They request shipments originate from Ireland due to EU data center.
Rafael (procurement): Proposal: re-issue PO with Ireland vendor ledger and bill run through our EU billing flow. That keeps marketplace flow intact but requires partner vendor mapping update (48h).
Liam (sales): Re-issue acceptable if co-marketing payout still tracks. Partner says co-sell requires marketplace invoice metadata.
Priya (legal): I'm OK with manual accept plus indemnity if partner signs addendum clarifying VAT responsibility. I can draft a 1-pager.
Jordan (finance): If legal provides indemnity language, finance can expedite manual accept within 4 hours. Need procurement to attach proof of VAT/W9.
Gracie (partnerships): Action items: Rafael open partnerops ticket for vendor ledger remap and attach docs; Priya draft indemnity; Jordan standby for approve; Liam update customer and partner on timeline.
Rafael (procurement): Creating ticket now.

```
PO: AMZ-45812
issue: vendor_ledger_mismatch + shipping_country_mismatch
partner_docs: [VAT-IE-7788.pdf, W9-ACMEUS.pdf]
requested_action: vendor ledger remap to IE + manual accept if needed
```

mp-bot: Ticket AZ-7731 created; partner notified; expected response SLA=48h
Priya (legal): Drafting indemnity addendum, will share in channel in ~2h.
Liam (sales): Told customer were working an expedited path; they said ok to provisional go-live if billing finalizes within 72h.
Jordan (finance): On standby. Ping me when indemnity ready.
Gracie (partnerships): I'll track this in the marketplace tracker and escalate to partner ops leadership if no movement in 24h. :eyes:
mp-bot: AZ-7731 status=OPEN; last_update=1758890601
